title: Language Models are Alignable Decision-Makers: Dataset and Application to the Medical Triage Domain
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on decision-maker attributes (DMAs) such as protocol focus, fairness, risk aversion, continuing care, moral desert, and utilitarianism in a medical triage context.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
references: Mark D. Alicke. 2000. Culpable control and the psychology of blame. Psychological Bulletin, 126(4):556–574.
